Latest GA 2016-09-01 cannot preserve this configuration: its REST route is the fixed /diagnosticSettings/service path, it has no logAnalyticsDestinationType property, and its inherited Resource requires location while the current 2021 preview removed location and this source omits it.
results.migration: Not feasible without changing behavior or resource shape: current uses custom name sre-github-vault-audit and logAnalyticsDestinationType=Dedicated; GA 2016-09-01 has a fixed service route and no Dedicated destination property, and requires location.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original Bicep /name maps to current preview route parameter {name}:string; literal sre-github-vault-audit is valid as a name string. GA candidate route is fixed to /diagnosticSettings/service and cannot preserve this custom name.

usage.label: scope
usage.analysis: Original Bicep /scope is Bicep extension-resource scope, not a JSON body field; AKS or vault resource ID maps to current required string route parameter {resourceUri}.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: Original /properties maps to DiagnosticSettings. Current preview has workspaceId, logAnalyticsDestinationType, and logs fields; GA has only workspaceId/logs and other sink fields, lacking logAnalyticsDestinationType.

usage.label: workspaceId
usage.analysis: REST properties.workspaceId is a string ARM resource ID in both current preview and GA; source string parameter supplies that value.

usage.label: logAnalyticsDestinationType
usage.analysis: Current preview schema defines this as string, and Learn documents Dedicated as an allowed value; literal 'Dedicated' is valid. The 2016-09-01 GA model omits this property entirely, so the chosen dedicated-table behavior cannot migrate unchanged.

usage.label: logs
usage.analysis: REST properties.logs is an array of LogSettings in both schemas. Each item requires enabled:boolean; item fields are checked individually.

usage.label: category
usage.analysis: REST LogSettings.category is string in current preview and GA; each source category literal is a string. Exact category availability for the target resource is provider/environment metadata and was not queried.

usage.label: enabled
usage.analysis: REST LogSettings.enabled is required boolean; source literal true satisfies the type in both current preview and GA.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: Resource header uses Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings@2021-05-01-preview. It is the latest Learn-listed preview; this declaration's custom resource name and Dedicated mode motivate retaining preview.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: String parameter contains the Log Analytics workspace resource ID; it maps to REST properties.workspaceId:string.

results.exclusion_reason: Retain the latest preview for this declaration because it explicitly configures Dedicated Log Analytics tables and a named diagnostic setting. The only published GA candidate cannot represent those choices and requires a location absent from the source; silently downgrading would not be equivalent.

current.analysis: Exact Learn current page and pinned preview diagnosticsSettings_API.json were read. PUT route includes /diagnosticSettings/{name}; DiagnosticSettings has workspaceId:string, logs array, and logAnalyticsDestinationType:string. Learn says Dedicated is an allowed value. LogSettings.category is string and enabled:boolean is required. Current source values match this schema.

ga.analysis: Learn selector shows latest stable GA 2016-09-01; fixed REST tree has stable serviceDiagnosticsSettings schemas at 2015-07-01 and 2016-09-01. Exact candidate route is fixed at /diagnosticSettings/service, ServiceDiagnosticSettings omits logAnalyticsDestinationType, and inherited Resource requires location. This source uses a custom name and Dedicated and omits location, so candidate is not behaviorally compatible.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2021-05-01-preview says the preview resource removed location and added systemData; current source omits location as permitted by the preview schema. Comparing current preview with stable GA shows the older GA requires location, uses the fixed service route, and lacks logAnalyticsDestinationType. The preview-only dedicated-table behavior and custom name are retained; no implicit downgrade is made.

results.name: baselineAlerts
results.reason: Exact current 2026-01-01 Learn and REST schemas agree and Learn marks this version Latest. Required MetricAlertProperties fields are present; PromQLCriteria and each criterion satisfy the discriminator, item, and required fields. Identity, maps, customProperties, and resolution settings match resolved types. Parameter constraints and every loop-derived value were checked.
results.migration: Current GA; Learn marks 2026-01-01 Latest and the fixed-commit tree has stable metricAlert API schemas at 2018-03-01 and 2026-01-01, with 2026-01-01 highest. No newer GA version.

current.analysis: Fetched exact Learn resource page and pinned stable OpenAPI. The request body uses Identity, which resolves through common TrackedResource: location:string is required, tags is an optional object with additionalProperties:string, and identity properties are optional. The PUT path requires resourceName:string. All four declarations supply location and use string-valued name expressions and the common string-valued tag map.

ga.analysis: Learn selector identifies 2024-11-30 as latest stable; later 2025-01-31-preview and 2025-05-31-preview are previews. The complete pinned REST subtree has stable userAssignedIdentities schemas 2018-11-30, 2023-01-31, and 2024-11-30; 2024-11-30 is latest GA and already current.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2024-11-30 lists only an addition under UserAssignedIdentityProperties; no used name, location, or tags contract changed. This declaration set does not use identity properties, so the additive field is irrelevant to its payloads.
